reasons.reproducibility: Whole-lake H2O2 application at 2 mg/L requires permits and industrial dosing equipment.
reasons.effectiveness: Cyanobacteria and microcystin fell 99% within days and stayed low for 7 weeks after lab and enclosure tests.
reasons.time: Photosynthetic vitality fell >70% within hours, 99% within a few days.
reasons.environment: H2O2 gone within days and non-target groups largely unaffected, though it is an added oxidant.

reasons.reproducibility: 250 mL flask trials with kelp/Ulva and Alexandrium are bench-doable, but toxic culture needs a sponsor.
reasons.effectiveness: -17-74% at 2-3 d and -42-96% at ~1 wk; mesocosm kelp -73% in 48 h but total chl did not fall.
reasons.environment: Retrievable seaweed, but Ulva raised pH to 9-10 and other algae replaced the target.

reasons.reproducibility: Planting 3.2 M adult clams in 64 plots across Shinnecock Bay is a permitted field program.
reasons.effectiveness: Brown tide fell from 0.3-1.9x10^6 to <10^4 cells/mL, large but correlational without a concurrent control.
reasons.cost: Far over $5,000 for millions of clams.
reasons.environment: Native clams only; harvests rose 16x, no harm reported.

reasons.reproducibility: Field modified-clay spraying at 4-10 t/km2 needs vessels and industrial quantities.
reasons.effectiveness: Modified clays remove cells up to hundreds of times better than natural clay and are widely used in China, but no percentage given in the record.
reasons.cost: Tonnes of clay per km2 exceed $5,000.
reasons.environment: Clay settles to the seabed and is not retrieved (persistent material), despite the authors' 'no negative effects' claim.

reasons.reproducibility: Canal field trial with rotting straw needs site access.
reasons.effectiveness: Reduced filamentous algae per summary, but no numbers or controls seen.
reasons.time: Not reported; rotting straw takes months.

reasons.reproducibility: Bench cultures of Microcystis with common oxidants (chlorine, KMnO4, H2O2) are school-doable with a sponsor; ozone needs a generator.
reasons.effectiveness: Chlorine compromised >=88% of cells in 1 min and ozone lysed 90% in 5 min.
reasons.environment: All oxidants lyse cells and release toxins; CuSO4 leaves persistent copper.
